producer_report.summary:
A retry now starts the producer from the rejected candidate when the rejected job passed every check and its only unmet criteria are content criteria. Every other retry still starts from the base. The producer's brief carries the verifier's findings and the unmet criteria. The new candidate is still diffed against the original base and fully checked and verified. A seeded producer that changes nothing fails as "the producer made no change".

I ran the whole workspace test suite with `--no-fail-fast`, and it had two failures, both caused by this change:
- The backtest of `docs/decisions.md` flagged a bare "Supersedes:" phrase in the new decision. I reworded it.
- The lifecycle test `retrying_a_retry_carries_the_original_request_redacted` had its retry write the same file content as the seeded tree, so it correctly failed as an empty candidate. Its second attempt now writes different content and is routed to the second scenario for the producer too.

I reran only those two tests and they passed. I did not rerun the whole suite after the fixes, so Athena's own run is the final confirmation.

How it works:
- **The rule:** `qualifies_for_tree_retry(state, candidate, verification)` in `reading.rs` reads records only. It requires:
  - the job is rejected;
  - the candidate has a commit and a tree and no violations;
  - at least one check was recorded, all passed, and there is no reading mismatch;
  - at least one unmet criterion, every unmet criterion is of kind content, and no behavior criterion is unmet or cites a command never seen.
  `tree_retry_seed` resolves "try again on <job>" and returns the seed with redacted findings.
- **The snapshot:** `Athena::tree_seed` in `run.rs` also falls back to the base when the candidate or base commit is missing, or when any path outside `records/` changed since the rejected job's base. Seeding from the old candidate would otherwise undo later landed work.
- **The snapshot variant:** `SnapshotRepo::BaseThenTree` commits the base and leaves the candidate's files uncommitted in the work tree, so `change_list` is still against the base. `Snapshot::unchanged_since_seed` is how an idle seeded producer is detected.
- **The briefs:** the producer brief gains a retry section and a working-directory paragraph that says the work starts from the rejected candidate. The reader brief now says a retry starts from the base, except for this case. `README.md` and the `drain.rs` doc comment say the same.
- **The record:** the CHANGELOG [Unreleased] entry and a new decision, D117, list each caller with its covering test, the commands run, the alternatives, and the supersession of earlier "always from the base" text.

open_issues: Departure from the plan: criteria 4 and 5 name `cargo test -p athena-core`, but those tests are in crates/athena-cli/tests/retry.rs, because athena-core has no change capability to run an end-to-end retry. run_pin_tests.rs and pin.rs are unchanged. The athena-core unit tests cover the rule and the seed.
crates/athena-cli/tests/lifecycle.rs was edited though it is not in the expected deliverables: an existing test needed different content for its retry once idle seeded retries fail.
crates/athena-git/src/snapshot.rs was also edited (additive variant and method), as the plan said.
The 40 minute and 3 dollar saving is from the request and was not measured.
A rejection with no unmet criterion (for example a blocker finding alone) restarts from the base by design.
The whole suite was not rerun after the last two fixes; only the two affected tests were.
mistakes: I wrote 'all passed' in a draft CHANGELOG edit before the full suite had run; that edit failed on a duplicate anchor and I rewrote the text with the real results.
I ran the full workspace test suite twice (once in the background, whose output I could not read, then again quiet), against the one-run guidance, to find the two failures.
My first fix for the lifecycle test only changed the second scenario's edits, but the script routed producers to the first scenario, so it still failed; I then routed the producer by call count.
learnings: The seeded retry's prediction commit differs from the rejected job's base by records/ only when no other work landed, so the check is 'no changed path outside records/' and not commit equality.
Git::diff_tree accepts commit ids, so no peeling to trees is needed.

docs/decisions.md is parsed by crates/athena-cli/tests/backtest.rs: a bare 'supersedes', 'superseded by' or 'amends' phrase at a statement start with no D-number fails it, and one with a D-number must be listed in docs/decision-links.toml, which only the user confirms.
The fake script in tests/common/mod.rs routes by role only, so tests that need different behavior for a retry must route by call count themselves.
The athena-core crate has no change capability available, so end-to-end retry tests belong in athena-cli/tests.
desires: A way to read the background task's output file, which the working-directory policy blocked, so I did not have to rerun the suite to find the failures.
